DomainOntology.comment: An agent's runtime-proposed domain ontology (EA-3 §4, the hyperbaric knowledge chamber). Born-RDF testimony: the in-graph record of a VocabularyContract the agent PROPOSED mid-benchmark as its provisional, defeasible model of THIS benchmark's implicit domain logic. The CORE world-model meta-ontology (Entity/Event/State/Relation/Disposition) is frozen/embedded and never touched here; this is the agent's DOMAIN layer, scoped to its chamber graph, revisable (propose v2 supersedes v1). The full contract JSON is carried as a chm:contractJson literal (round-trippable via serde_json); the ontology's SHACL shapes are derived on-read via vocab_to_shacl(). Subject is a VERSIONED LOGICAL id (identity_kind=logical-id): {name}-v{version}, NOT a content hash. Re-proposing the same name+version with IDENTICAL content converges to zero ops (idempotent); with DIFFERENT content it is REJECTED (published versions are immutable testimony — bump the version or supersede). A NEW version mints a NEW subject and supersedes the old.

chm:ontologyName.source: the proposed vocab's name (e.g. 'bench-domain'); the identity key across versions

chm:ontologyVersion.source: semantic version of the proposed ontology (e.g. '1.0.0')

chm:namespace.source: the proposed ontology's primary namespace URI

chm:rationale.source: the agent's reasoning for this domain model (benchmark context)

chm:contractJson.source: the full proposed VocabularyContract as a JSON literal (round-trippable; the source of truth for the derived SHACL shapes)

chm:observer.source: the agent id that proposed this ontology (observer-relative testimony)

chm:supersedes.source: older DomainOntology subject(s) this proposal replaces (v2 -> v1 edge)

chm:supersededBy.source: the newer ontology that supersedes this one (the demote back-pointer)

chm:proposedAt.source: epoch-ms when this ontology was proposed

comment: The Emporium CHAMBER vocab (EA-3 §4). A built-in pack — NOT a memory/workflow/salience pack — whose single DomainOntology class stores the agent's RUNTIME-PROPOSED domain ontologies as born-RDF (Vera's 'one gardend for all RDF'; the proposal is IN-GRAPH testimony, not a SQL row). The agent proposes a domain ontology via the propose_domain_ontology MCP tool; Emporium validates it (parse -> vocab_to_shacl -> rudof compile-check), stores it here, and thereafter validates the agent's INSTANCES of that ontology against its OWN derived shapes. chm: subjects are URN-space; the projection lives ONLY in urn:mnemosyne:local:graph:{id}:projection:chamber and is DERIVED/regenerable, never source of truth.
description: The hyperbaric knowledge chamber: agent-as-ontology-author. Stores runtime-proposed domain ontologies (mem:DomainOntology / chm:DomainOntology) as born-RDF, the foundation the memory benchmark stands on.
